run_main_token_generation: run the main function to generate tokens from a vLLM inference endpoint
create_http_client_vllm: create an httpx client configured for the vLLM online serving generate endpoint
build_token_ids_from_chat: build token IDs from chat messages using AutoTokenizer.apply_chat_template
test_token_generation_flow: test the full token generation flow from chat messages to decoded output text
review_main_function: review the main function that sends a generation request and decodes the response tokens
